meta.scope: Myanmar Batch 4 — Labour market, fiscal deficit, and border trade densification under constrained conditions.

candidates.title: Labour force and employment statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from ILO modelled estimates and national sources
candidates.description: Labour-force participation, employment-to-population ratio and unemployment rates. Participation is in the low-60s percent range; unemployment is moderate by modelled estimates, but informal employment and underemployment are widespread and conflict has disrupted livelihoods.
candidates.notes: Primary labour-market node under constrained survey conditions.

candidates.title: Fiscal balance and budget deficit statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from World Bank-aligned and national fiscal monitoring
candidates.description: Fiscal balance and deficit indicators. The deficit has widened in recent fiscal years (mid-single-digit percent of GDP range) under reconstruction, security and recurrent spending pressures, with weak tax collection and reliance on domestic financing including central-bank channels.
candidates.notes: Core fiscal-flow node under constrained revenue and elevated spending pressures.

candidates.title: Border trade statistics and framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from Ministry of Commerce and monitoring sources
candidates.description: Statistics and analytical framing of official and informal border trade, especially with China and Thailand. Border trade volumes have fluctuated sharply with conflict, checkpoint control and infrastructure disruption; informal and non-state-controlled flows remain material.
candidates.notes: High-centrality trade densification under fragmented territorial control.

candidates.title: Myanmar labour–fiscal–border densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from labour, fiscal and trade sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding labour force statistics, fiscal balance/deficit indicators, and border trade framing into a coherent labour–fiscal–trade layer under constrained conditions.
